Container.Name: MyNeS
Container.Overview:
MyNeS (My Network Scanner) discovers, identifies and monitors every device on your home network - including the ones an IP scan cannot see.
Beyond ARP and port scanning it speaks mDNS/Bonjour, SSDP/UPnP, Matter, Bluetooth LE and MQTT, so Zigbee bulbs behind Zigbee2MQTT, Z-Wave sensors behind Z-Wave JS, BLE trackers and Tasmota nodes show up next to your servers and phones.
- Device inventory with vendor lookup over a 1000+ entry OUI database - Automatic device-type classification (router, NAS, camera, console, smart plug, ...) - Network topology and force-directed graph views - Scan history: when a device first appeared, when it went quiet - Rule-based monitoring with alerts by Web Push, webhook, e-mail or Home Assistant - Two-way Home Assistant integration over MQTT Discovery and REST/WebSocket - Turkish and English UI, light and dark themes, installable as a PWA
No cloud, no account, no telemetry. Only scan networks you own.
Container.Requires:
**Host networking is required.** ARP, mDNS and SSDP discovery only work from the host network namespace. NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW are added so MyNeS can send raw ARP frames; without them it falls back to a ping sweep plus the OS ARP cache and finds fewer devices.
After install, open http://[IP]:5883.
Container.Changes: ### 1.4.0 - Web Push notifications sent by MyNeS itself, plus a direct Home Assistant alert channel - Editable regex identification patterns - Settings and home-plan pass

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port the MyNeS web interface listens on. Host networking is in use, so this is the real host port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Device inventory, scan history and alerts.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Optional. Lets MyNeS name your containers and the docker networks behind the br-* bridges. Remove it to keep the Docker API out of MyNeS.

Config.Name: Master Password
Config.Description: Encrypts stored device credentials. Leave empty and MyNeS generates one on first start.

Config.Name: MQTT Broker Host
Config.Description: Optional. Reads retained Zigbee2MQTT / Z-Wave JS / Tasmota / Home Assistant discovery topics - the only way to see radio devices.
